svg.title: UC-05 Respond to substitute request — first acceptance wins (FR-09, FR-10, BR-02, NFR-04)

g.text: UC-05 Respond to substitute request — first acceptance wins (FR-09, FR-10, BR-02, NFR-04)
both candidates see the same PENDING
real code (services.js respondToRequest): SQLite has no SELECT ... FOR UPDATE.
"first acceptance wins" is enforced by a conditional UPDATE whose WHERE clause
re-checks status, plus db.getRowsModified() (returned here as changes) to see
whether this call's UPDATE actually won the row.
the WHERE status='REQUESTED' clause and the changes
check happen inside the same transaction as the update,
so only one of the two UPDATEs can affect a row — the
other always affects 0 rows and is refused (BR-02).
(a request already fully settled before this call even
starts is instead caught earlier as ALREADY_TAKEN /
REQUEST_CLOSED, by the initial status read above)
